title: Remove unused references
body:
Found by adding a warning to wattsi:
https://github.com/whatwg/wattsi/pull/17

[AGIF] and [UNDO] were both used inside comments. The [AGIF] link is
404, so remove that. Keep [UNDO] for later untangling.

These are the commits when each reference was last seen in source:
